RECENT_DIALOGUE message IDs are not candidates and must never appear in contexts. When CANDIDATE_IDS is empty, contexts must be empty even if recent dialogue exists. Also extract explicit new user background, decisions and decision revisions from CURRENT_QUESTION into registrations. Do not register simple questions or requests. content must be an exact contiguous substring of CURRENT_QUESTION and source_id must be that question's ID. Do not promote hypotheses into confirmed decisions. Use project scope only when explicitly stated in the original. For revisions, supersedes must be the active decision ID from CURRENT_DECISIONS. registrations schema: [{"title":"Title","content":"Exact original quote","kind":"background|reference|hypothesis|decision","scope":"project|topic","topics":["Topic"],"source_id":"Current question ID","supersedes":null}].
